pairs.l: 1 — Government building. Guard will ask for proof of who you are.
pairs.r: B — You need to take your ID.

pairs.l: 2 — You'd love this place. I'm so sorry you couldn't join us.
3 — The castle is not far. We can walk there. Just comfortable shoes.
pairs.r: D — We can go there on foot.

pairs.l: 4 — All expenses covered, but food is not included.
pairs.r: C — Food is not included in the price.

pairs.l: 5 — Let's go shopping. Designer clothes at bargain prices.

r1.exp: Poruka 1 (vlada, trebate dokaz identiteta) = B (You need to take your ID). Poruka 2 (žao mi je što nisi s nama) = F (Wish you were here). Poruka 3 (možemo hodati, samo udobne cipele) = D (We can go there on foot). Poruka 4 (sve je pokriveno, ali hrana nije) = C (Food is not included). Poruka 5 (shopping, sniženja počinju subotom) = A (Sales start on Saturday).

r6.exp: Dućani normalno rade do 20:00, ali danas zatvaraju sat ranije → 19:00 = B.

r7.exp: Mason je bio uzbuđen ali ostavio je materijale kod kuće → 'had such great expectations' a ispalo loše = C (Disappointing / razočaravajuće za njega).

r8.exp: 'Just want to KEEP IN GOOD CONDITION, like me' → Sam je pristupio da ostane u formi = C (To stay fit).

r9.exp: Roditelju ne sviđaju se tetovaže, glazba i dečko — ali ključni: 'They don't like my BOYFRIEND' → specifični problem = C. Glazbu rješava slušalicama, tetovaža je nova, ali dečko je eksplicitno navedeno 'don't like'.

r10.exp: 'Thanks for the CD' → Isaac je DOBIO (posudio) CD od Edwarda = B. Knjiga je Isaacova (traži je natrag), a DVD tek traži.

r11.exp: 'Called her JIMMY, short for gymnastics' → nadimak je Jimmy.

r12.exp: 'Growing up in the Garston area of WATFORD' → rodni grad je Watford.

r13.exp: 'Her job as a SALES ASSISTANT in a local sports shop' → zanimanje je sales assistant (prodavačica).

r14.exp: 'I'd love to be an ASTRONAUT' → posao iz snova je astronaut.

r15.exp: 'T-shirt with MORTON, the name of the sports shop' → sponzorovo ime je Morton.

r16.exp: 'Ask everybody to suggest (16)____.' → C: where they would like to go. Na obiteljskom sastanku svi predlažu kamo bi željeli ići.

r17.exp: 'Make sure it's the right place for everybody (17)____.' → B: before you make final arrangements. Provjeri je li pravo mjesto za sve prije konačnih dogovora.

r18.exp: 'Teenagers need (18)____.' → F: to be involved in various daily activities. Tinejdžeri trebaju biti uključeni u aktivnosti.

r19.exp: 'Not an option (19)____.' → A: for a teenager bursting with endless energy. Gledanje TV nije opcija za tinejdžera prepunog energije.

r20.exp: 'Remember what it was like (20)____. Why not try to be like one again?' → D: when you were a teenager. Sjeti se kako je bilo kad si bio/la tinejdžer.

r21.exp: 'Communicate WITH each other' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: communicate with someone.

r22.exp: 'Makes UP more than 50%' — frazalni glagol: make up = čine, sačinjavaju (određeni udio).

r23.exp: 'Not saying ANYTHING' — u negativnoj rečenici koristimo 'anything' (ne 'nothing' jer bi to bila dvostruka negacija).

r24.exp: 'Hundreds of courses HAVE been designed' — present perfect passive s množinom subjekta (hundreds → have).

r25.exp: 'Just a FEW changes' — 'few' uz brojivu imenicu (changes). 'A little' ide uz nebrojivu imenicu.

r26.exp: 'Learning facts BY heart' — fiksni izraz: learn by heart = naučiti napamet.

r27.exp: 'Difficult TO get started' — infinitiv uz pridjeve: difficult to + infinitiv.

r28.exp: 'If THERE are things you don't understand' — egzistencijalna konstrukcija: there are.

r29.exp: 'Longer THAN 45 minutes' — komparativ: longer than (dulje od).

r30.exp: 'Reward YOURSELF with something you like' — povratna zamjenica: yourself (nagradi sebe).

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) kako ste se upoznali, (2) što najviše voliš kod svog najboljeg prijatelja/ice, (3) što obično radite zajedno. Dužina 50–70 riječi. Neformalan registar.

w1.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva 3 pitanja), jezik i dužina (50–70 riječi). Napomena: 2015. ispit traži 50–70 riječi (stariji format).
